description: This file defines the SignalMasker class, which provides an RAII interface for blocking signals within a scope, and declares a function to change signal handlers. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and includes signal handling utilities.

classes.name: SignalMasker
classes.description: A class that blocks specified signals for the lifetime of its instance, providing RAII semantics for signal masking.

methods.name: SignalMasker
methods.description: Constructor that blocks the specified signals until the object is destroyed.

methods.name: ChangeSignalHandlers
methods.description: Function to set a custom signal handler for a list of signals.
